changes_vs_current: Zootopia (was #1 in first pass), Encanto, Lilo & Stitch, Emperor's New Groove, Wreck-It Ralph, Big Hero 6 and Winnie the Pooh drop out for lack of public-preference evidence; Lion King back to #1, then Aladdin, Beauty and the Beast, Moana, Frozen; Alice in Wonderland, Pocahontas, Robin Hood, Hunchback enter on 2020 search volume only.
confidence: low-medium. Top 5 (Lion King, Aladdin, Beauty and the Beast, Moana, Frozen) is well supported by 4 independent US sources including a hundreds-of-thousands-vote fan bracket and YouGov. Below that, evidence is thin and old-skewed (search volume of pre-2000 films, inflation-adjusted attendance); modern favorites (Tangled, Lilo & Stitch, Encanto, Zootopia, Little Mermaid at 21) are probably understated because no readable source ranks post-2010 films beyond Moana/Frozen. Position 24 (Tangled) is a no-data placeholder. Ranker, IMDb and the YouGov per-movie pages were unreadable.
